Filling_level.label: Filling level
Filling_level.description: The uCIFI filling level sensor measures how full and/or how empty a container (e.g. waste, fuel) is and reports it either in percentage or in centimeters. The filling level sensor may be complemented with a temperature sensor to compose a waste filling sensor that can also identify waste container fire.

Actual_filling_percentage.label: Actual filling percentage
Actual_filling_percentage.description: Percentage of container filled with content.

Actual_filling_level.label: Actual filling level
Actual_filling_level.description: Height of content in the container.

High_threshold.label: High threshold
High_threshold.description: Threshold above which the container is considered full.

Container_full.label: Container full
Container_full.description: Set to True if the actual filling percentage is above the high threshold.

Low_threshold.label: Low threshold
Low_threshold.description: Threshold below which the container is considered empty.

Container_empty.label: Container empty
Container_empty.description: Set to True if the actual filling percentage is below the low threshold.

Forecast_full_date.label: Forecast full date
Forecast_full_date.description: Next date at which the container should reach the high threshold.

Forecast_empty_date.label: Forecast empty date
Forecast_empty_date.description: Next date at which the container should reach the low threshold.

Container_out_of_location.label: Container out of location
Container_out_of_location.description: Set to True if the container is not at the location where it should be.

Container_out_of_position.label: Container out of position
Container_out_of_position.description: Set to True if the container is not in correct upright position.
